Initial version of the detail design document for RTA-SUM PNC 8.0.1 for SDV 2.0. \\The tools version have been updated. \\ Update Section \ref{section:GenericComponentIF}: Update ports for DIDs F08B and F08D. \\ Update Section \ref{subsection:general}: Remove User optinal parameters for DIDs F08B and F08D. \\ Update Section \ref{subsec:EventTriggeredRunnable}: Remove runnables for DID F08C. Modified subsection \ref{subsec:periodic} to declare the Runnable_Pnc_Init of configurable periodicity. \\ Modified subsection ~\ref{subsection:LocalActivation} to update state machine with added PNC_BswM_CurrentPNCModeReq calls.\\ Updated section ~\ref{section:Environment} adding MemMapGen tool. \\ Updated section ~\ref{subsection:SumSusd} publish record ID info from SUM_PNC to update activity records. \\ Added new section \ref{sec:WakeupReasonTracking} describing local and remote partial network activation history management and SUSD record info dispatch mechanism. \\ Updated section ~\ref{subsection:SumSusd} to document the SUSD_PNC_UpdateRecord interface: added RecordIdType struct and RID_Enum type definitions, and documented wakeup reason selection rules for local and remote activation categories. \\ Updated section ~\ref{subsection:LocalActivation} to document local activation history buffer management functions. \\ Added private function designs for record info dispatch, local activation and deactivation history,NM activation history sorting and merging. \\ Updated PNC_NM_Frame_Indication to document NM activation and deactivation history updates.
